quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #3
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: Your wheels slip off the edge of the road while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Jerk the steering wheel to force the vehicle back onto the road.
Speed up and steer back onto the road gradually.
Slam on your brakes and stop.
Gently brake and slowly turn the steering wheel to return to the road at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gently brake and slowly turn the steering wheel to return to the road at a safe speed.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle leaves the road, keep the wheels off the pavement and gently apply the brakes to slow down. Once you reach a safe speed, turn the steering wheel to return to the road. Do not try to force the vehicle back by turning the wheel sharply.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming traffic signal. Be ready to stop for a red light or proceed for a green light, and watch for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road is crossing a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road is crossing a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road is crossing a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roadways separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is showing red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is showing green.
A traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A traffic signal is coming up ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that there is a traffic signal at the next intersection ahead.

questions.question: When a driver behind you wants to pass, what should you do?

options.text: Slow down to give the other driver room in front of you to pass safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to give the other driver room in front of you to pass safely.
questions.explanation: Slow down when a driver behind you wants to pass. This gives them enough room in front of your vehicle to complete the pass quickly and safely.

questions.question: What should you do when being tailgated?

options.text: Move to the right lane if one is available.
If no right lane is available, wait for clear road ahead and slowly reduce speed to let the tailgater pass.

questions.explanation: If being tailgated, move to the right lane if available. If not, wait for clear road ahead and slowly reduce speed to let them pass. Never brake suddenly, as this increases the risk of being hit from behind.

questions.question: What is the best way to reduce your risk of injury or death in a car crash?

options.text: Stay in the right lane on multilane highways.
Only drive between 3:00 p.m. and 6:00 p.m.

questions.explanation: Wearing your seat belt is the most effective way to reduce your risk of death or injury while driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What colors are warning signs that show upcoming hazards?

options.text: Black letters or symbols on a white background
Black letters or symbols on a yellow background
White letters or symbols on a blue background
White letters or symbols on a green background

questions.correctAnswerText: Black letters or symbols on a yellow background
questions.explanation: Warning signs have yellow backgrounds with black letters or symbols. Work zone warning signs are orange with black letters or symbols.

questions.question: Another driver is trying to pass your car. What should you do?

options.text: Signal to the other driver when it is safe for them to pass.
Check for oncoming traffic and adjust your speed to allow safe passing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for oncoming traffic and adjust your speed to allow safe passing.
questions.explanation: Stay to the right when another driver passes you on the left. Check for oncoming traffic and slow down so the other vehicle can move back into your lane safely.

questions.question: When you see an accident scene, what should you do?

options.text: Keep your attention on your driving.
Stop if you are involved or if emergency help has not yet arrived.

questions.explanation: Only stop if you are involved in the accident or emergency help has not arrived yet. Keep your attention on your driving and keep moving. Watch for people on or near the road. Do not stop just to look at an accident.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light to tell drivers that left-turning traffic must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: A fire engine is following you on a two-lane street without its emergency signals on. What should you do?

options.text: Continue to drive in a normal manner.
Stop as quickly as you can.
Speed up to get out of its way.
Slow down, move as far to the right as possible, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue to drive in a normal manner.
questions.explanation: If an emergency vehicle is following you without its siren or flashing lights on, you do not need to move. Drive normally.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: When driving, you must stop your vehicle:

options.text: At an intersection with a stop sign.
Where there is a red light.
When a traffic officer orders you to stop.

questions.explanation: You must stop at stop signs, red lights, and whenever a traffic officer tells you to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting. The road will split into two one-way roads separated by a barrier. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: A pedestrian starts to cross in front of your vehicle. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up and pass in front of the pedestrian.
Stop and let the pedestrian cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let the pedestrian cross.
questions.explanation: Always give pedestrians the right-of-way. Slow down and stop when you see pedestrians crossing. Be extra careful around children. Let pedestrians cross in crosswalks.

questions.question: You are approaching a railroad crossing with a crossbuck sign but no gates or flashing lights. What should you do?

options.text: Approach with extreme caution and cross only when you know no train is coming.
Turn your radio down so you can listen for a train.
Only continue if a flagger tells you it is safe.

questions.explanation: Always approach railroad crossings with extreme caution. Look both ways and make sure no train is coming before crossing. Lower your radio volume to listen for trains. If a flagger is present, follow their instructions.

questions.question: How can you prevent hydroplaning?

options.text: Make sure your tires have good tread.
Slow down when driving in rain.

questions.explanation: To prevent hydroplaning, keep your tire tread in good condition and maintain proper tire pressure. Slow down when driving in rain. Hydroplaning happens more often at high speeds.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right and then left.
The road ahead curves left and then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right and then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and are diamond-shaped. This sign warns you that the road curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange and warn you about work zones ahead. Slow down and drive carefully when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first if needed. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black letters or symbols. They alert you to potential hazards ahead.

questions.question: Can you drive around or under a railroad crossing gate that is moving?

options.text: Yes, if the train is not too close.
Yes, if your vehicle fits without hitting the gate.
Yes, if you look both ways carefully.

questions.explanation: When you see flashing red lights, bells, or lowered gates at a railroad crossing, you must stop completely. Do not go around or under the gate. Wait until the lights stop and the gate is fully up before crossing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead and another road comes in from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you of a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What safety restraints work best in a crash?

options.text: Only a lap and shoulder belt.
Both a lap/shoulder belt and an airbag.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both a lap/shoulder belt and an airbag.
questions.explanation: Safety belts double your chance of surviving a crash and reduce serious injury. Airbags work best when used with safety belts in a front-end crash. Always wear both your shoulder and lap belts.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with more than one track?

options.text: Wait until you can see all tracks clearly before moving.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
Go through as soon as the train passes.
Go through when one track is free.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see all tracks clearly before moving.
questions.explanation: At a crossing with multiple tracks, do not move when the first train passes. Wait until you can see all tracks clearly. Another train may be coming on a different track.

questions.question: When parallel parking, park within ____ inches of the curb.
questions.explanation: When parallel parking, keep your wheels within 12 inches of the curb. Park in a location that does not block traffic and where other drivers can see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: If someone is injured in an accident, what should you do?

options.text: Move the injured person away immediately.
Do not move them unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid.
Stay away from the injured person.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not move them unless necessary. Keep them warm and give first aid.
questions.explanation: Do not move injured people unless necessary. Improper handling can turn minor injuries into serious ones. Keep them warm until help arrives. If there is heavy bleeding, apply direct pressure to stop it.

questions.question: For drivers 21 and older, what blood alcohol concentration (BAC) is illegal?
questions.explanation: Drivers 21 and older cannot legally drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08 percent or higher. Driving under the influence is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: Why should you use extra caution near a pedestrian with a white cane?
questions.explanation: A white cane signals that a pedestrian is blind. Slow down, yield the right-of-way, and be ready to stop. Take care to avoid hitting or injuring the pedestrian.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot safely enter the road or driveway from your direction. If you see this sign, turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What color are most warning signs?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about unexpected road conditions.

questions.question: In bad weather, how much following distance should you keep?
questions.explanation: More distance between your vehicle and others gives you more time to react. Keep four or five seconds of following distance in bad weather and heavy traffic.
